notes.title: The release is drawing closer - Steam Log #1
notes.content:
Hello, 

The first post on Steam for WiAB. 

I guess it's good if we start with a little bit of info and transparency.

Where it All Began (WiAB) plays in the same universe as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2240150/Summers_Gone__Season_1/]Summer's Gone[/url]... There is a gap of about twenty years in between.

If you like SG and its world, you should check out WiAB, and you might meet a few familiar faces. 

Just like SG, WiAB is a character-driven story, however, unlike SG's first season, WiAB already features sexual content. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It wasn't planned to release WiAB this early on Steam, especially not as an Early Access title, but exactly one year ago, WiAB lost its supporter page for reasons I still don't fully understand. 

It's now funding itself through SubscribeStar and some really awesome supporters, however, it hasn't recovered.

But before I put the game on ice indefinitely, I thought it would be a good way to have a shot at further developing it. 

WiAB - Season 1 will feature 8 chapters. 

I will soon finish Chapter 4, which is double the size of a normal update ~4000 images and then release it here on Steam. 

If you decide to get the game, the rest of the Season 1 chapters will be free of charge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004832/848b7850d18095b7162e39e6d9e6d089750e3916.png[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I post development logs for both games every two weeks. However, I will try to make it a habit to post here on Steam every month or two. 

It's just that if I work all day, I have no social energy left to write big posts. I keep postponing it and I'm sorry for this but, it's just how it is right now. 

But I'll give it a try. 
I will post summaries and a few of the previews. (I'm still not sure if I can post NSFW previews here, but I'll be playing it safe for now and keep it SFW.) 

Here are a few previews from Chapter 4: 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/vKFvtng/Katie-1.png[/img]

Besides postwork, I still need to finish the rest of the animations including a cinematic. 

I will make another post when I send the game to the Steam-tester boys, and afterwards, I'll announce a release date. 

- Ocean
